scope: Defines how a candidate is screened against an application profile before a CFD-7 dossier treats it as surviving the agreed application screen. Contains no candidate, source, value or threshold data.

allowed_screen_statuses.SCREEN_NOT_READY: The profile or register is not approved for candidate judgement, or the profile has no adopted screening constraint. No candidate can survive; dossier fields stay UNKNOWN and cannot be PASS.
allowed_screen_statuses.UNKNOWN: Identity is unresolved, or an adopted constraint has missing, predicted-only, overlapping or conflicting evidence.
allowed_screen_statuses.DEFERRED_PREDICTED_FAIL: Only a prediction or estimate fails an adopted constraint. The candidate is preserved for audit, separate from measured failures.
allowed_screen_statuses.EXCLUDED_MEASURED_HARD_FAIL: Source-traceable measured evidence fails an adopted hard constraint. Favourable evidence elsewhere cannot override it.
allowed_screen_statuses.SURVIVES_SCREEN: Every adopted hard constraint is met by measured evidence. This is not qualification and not a PASS for any dossier field.

evaluation_order.criterion: The register reports candidate_judgement_ready true and the profile_state is RESEARCH_FROZEN, CAMPAIGN_READY or QUALIFICATION_READY (project specification profile states). RESEARCH_DRAFT is never screened.

Only constraints with status ADOPTED, hard_rule_adopted true and candidate_screening_rule true are evaluated. PROPOSED or UNKNOWN constraints never screen a candidate. A profile with no adopted constraint is not ready.
Compound identity and isomer are resolved before any constraint is evaluated.
Any adopted constraint with MEASURED evidence and outcome OUTSIDE.
Any adopted constraint with PREDICTED evidence and outcome OUTSIDE.
Any adopted constraint with MISSING or PREDICTED evidence, or outcome OVERLAP or CONFLICT. A prediction inside the limit is not a measured pass.
Every adopted constraint has MEASURED evidence with outcome INSIDE.

invariants: The first matching step decides the status; later steps are not evaluated.
An unresolved adopted constraint cannot produce SURVIVES_SCREEN.
SURVIVES_SCREEN does not change any qualification field and never marks unassessed compatibility or supply as PASS.
Every screen decision records the rules version, the profile and the deciding step.
threshold_policy: This file adopts no numerical limit. Limits come only from constraints the decision owner adopts in the acceptability register.
